en: A monochrome (sepia-toned) image showing a massive medieval stone structure, likely a round or polygonal tower attached to a larger fortification. The tower has thick rough stone walls, small narrow window slits, a high arched opening, and a steep conical tiled roof. The surrounding area appears to be an open yard with bare ground in the foreground and trees framing the right and upper edges. There is a narrow printed border typical of early 20th‑century postcards. No visible caption or other printing appears on the front.
